reviewer.independence_basis: Separate GitHub review agent; repository-visible contributor/collaborator history contains only velantrian; the agent did not author A1-A10 or the integrated review, received the immutable reviewed subject after publication, and used the current runtime only as implementation-capture context rather than as architectural authority.

input_packet_read: P1-C5 contract/evidence/runtime context sufficient to test implementation capture
stable_candidate_claims: Context, Provenance and Authority are scoped
implementation/write order != causal or semantic precedence
Revision, Supersession and erasure are non-equivalent
loss and conformance must be explicit
claims_that_must_remain_provisional: A4 law package as one mandatory set
refutation_observations: A non-event realization preserves minimal claim/context/warrant/accountability purpose but cannot expose the A3/A6 catalogues: weaken the catalogues rather than reject the realization.
Bounded compaction preserves declared current semantics plus a loss witness but cannot reconstruct superseded detail: weaken universal reconstructability/history.
Profiles match final outputs while materially differing in provenance, uncertainty or Authority: refute full semantic equivalence for that scope.
An opaque substrate cannot provide independent physical-erasure evidence: physical erasure remains INDETERMINATE for that scope.

findings.finding: A8 permits too much profile-local discretion over scope, applicability, equivalence predicates and observable sufficiency, allowing a failed obligation to be excluded or relabeled after results are known.

findings.claim_or_obligation: substrate-neutral abstract machine and genuinely cross-lineage BPV-1
findings.finding: A3/A6 can reproduce the conceptual structure of the current Event/reducer laboratory even when Python and SQL are removed, so a language port could still be implementation capture in substance.

findings.claim_or_obligation: accountable revision, reconstructability and bounded-memory conformance
findings.finding: The blueprint does not define the retention bound or sufficient-summary rule needed to distinguish conformant forgetting/compaction from forbidden silent overwrite.

findings.claim_or_obligation: seven identity kinds and eight temporal dimensions
findings.finding: The identity/time inventories risk turning useful analysis vocabularies into mandatory Canon for realizations that can preserve scoped behavior without durable record/claim-act identities or every temporal dimension.

Non-conflation is valuable, but conflict/contradiction and alignment boundaries are not operationalized strongly enough to prevent post-hoc reclassification of a failed case as scope mismatch or a different Authority decision.

findings.claim_or_obligation: logical, physical, cryptographic erasure, restriction and forgetting remain distinguishable
findings.finding: The vocabulary is separable, but physical and cryptographic erasure require threat-scoped external evidence; a profile must not self-attest a stronger substrate condition through its own method.

findings.claim_or_obligation: BPV-1 must distinguish architectural failure from implementation failure
findings.finding: Materiality, scope, equivalence and required-obligation judgments remain adjustable enough that BPV-1 could be redesigned or rescoped after a counterexample unless hard refutation observations are preregistered.

findings.claim_or_obligation: provenance, history visibility, bounded accountability and conformance under adversarial behavior
findings.finding: No integrated architecture-level threat model names protected assets, trust roots, adversary capabilities or required behavior under forged provenance/Authority, fork, truncation, rollback, equivocation, colluding witnesses or a compromised conformance certifier.

findings.claim_or_obligation: Context, Provenance and Authority remain inspectable and portable without circularity or unbounded metadata
findings.finding: The blueprint lacks a finite grounding boundary, root-assumption model, cycle rule or stopping condition for contextual/provenance/Authority metadata, risking infinite regress or undeclared trusted roots.

findings.claim_or_obligation: distributed or decentralized realizations can preserve scoped semantics
findings.finding: The blueprint does not define composition/reconciliation/projection between independently evolving scoped Kernel configurations, so local conformance does not yet imply meaningful composed or federated conformance.
